jobs.title: Financial Analyst
jobs.description:
Overview

M42 delivers comprehensive healthcare services across the full continuum of care; from primary care to advanced specialty treatments. Leveraging cutting-edge health technologies and precision medicine, we ensure the highest standards of effectiveness, efficiency, and patient-centered outcomes. With a global presence spanning more than 480 facilities in 27 countries and a dedicated workforce of over 20,000 professionals, M42 is uniquely positioned to redefine the future of healthcare on a global scale

Established in 2022, Mubadala Health Dubai offers world-class treatments and advanced technology, facilitated by a clinical team of experts with extensive knowledge and experience. Our state-of-the-art outpatient facility provides day surgery, outpatient consultations, and comprehensive diagnostic services for over 30 clinical specialties.

The Financial Analyst will be responsible for financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and performance analysis to support the organisation’s financial objectives. The role involves monitoring financial performance, analysing revenue and expenditure trends, identifying financial risks and opportunities, and providing actionable insights to support informed business decisions. The position will work closely with key stakeholders to strengthen financial controls, optimise costs, improve operational efficiency, and ensure accurate and timely financial reporting.

Responsibilities

Prepare and analyse monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and compliance with financial reporting standards.
Manage budgeting and forecasting activities, including financial planning, budget preparation, and periodic forecast updates.
Monitor financial performance against approved budgets, investigate variances, and provide meaningful insights and recommendations to management.
Analyse revenue, operating expenses, profitability, and cost trends to identify opportunities for financial improvement and cost optimisation.
Develop and maintain financial models, dashboards, and management reports to support strategic planning and informed business decisions.
Perform financial reconciliations, validate financial data, and support month-end and year-end closing activities to ensure financial accuracy.
Collaborate with business units and key stakeholders to evaluate financial performance, assess business requirements, and provide financial guidance.
Conduct financial feasibility studies, scenario analysis, and ad hoc financial assessments to support business initiatives, investment decisions, and operational efficiency

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field.
Professional certifications such as ACCA, CMA, CPA, or CFA are preferred.
Minimum 3-5 years of relevant experience in financial analysis, financial planning and analysis (FP&A), budgeting, or financial reporting.
Proven experience in financial modelling, forecasting, budget preparation, and variance analysis.

Experience in the healthcare sector or a large corporate organisation would be an advantage.

Not Applicable

Employment type

Full-time

Industries

Hospitals and Health Care
